R851.note: Array-form exec still invokes cmd.exe /c on Windows; compiled and ran the fix and a quote-breakout payload (x" & echo INJECTED & echo ") still executes injected commands, so the vector is not fully closed.

R852.note: Fully replaces exec with nio Files API, but swallows IOException with printStackTrace instead of propagating like the original `throws Throwable` signature did, silently changing error-path behavior despite claiming to preserve it.

R853.note: Correct offset/capacity bounds check with no underflow; preserves nonzero-offset writes and the capacity parameter as required by the contract.

R854.note: Logs detailed error server-side, returns generic message to client; clean standard fix.

R855.note: Adds .RequireAuthorization() to the Minimal API endpoint; standard, correct, no side effects.

R856.note: Allowlist+host-check closes the redirect, but for the same input ('foo') the destination silently changes from the original relative URI to a different hardcoded '/dashboard', and any destination outside the invented 3-item allowlist is now rejected - disclosed as intentional design but not flagged as breaking other legitimate destinations.

R857.note: Adds secure=True (and samesite=Lax, stated plainly); standard clean fix.

R858.note: Adds CsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler, matching Spring Security's own documented SPA cookie/header CSRF configuration; clean, targeted fix.

R859.note: Logs full exception, returns generic message; clean standard fix.

R860.note: Parameterizes the ODBC query with '?' and keeps wildcarding in the parameter value; preserves search semantics.

R861.note: FromSqlInterpolated with nested interpolated wildcard term; compiled a standalone repro confirming it parameterizes to exactly {tenantId, "%term%"} as intended, preserving tenant filter and contains-search.

R862.note: Content-sniffing allowlist plus random filename correctly closes the upload vector, but the coupled read path (avatar_lookup.go) is never actually updated in the fix - only described in prose as something the caller 'must' do - so existing retrieval by original filename breaks; disclosed but not implemented, matching the stated contract's explicit warning.

R863.note: Denylist plus canonicalized-path containment check via toRealPath()/startsWith(); preserves existing 404-on-missing and download behavior.

R864.note: store.New() on a gorilla/sessions CookieStore still decodes any existing cookie and sets IsNew=false exactly like store.Get() (confirmed by gorilla/sessions source behavior), so this is a no-op that does not actually regenerate the session id or discard a planted cookie.

R865.note: Compiled the exact SanitizeForLogging method with dotnet: it embeds raw U+0085/U+2028/U+2029 characters directly inside char literals instead of \u0085/\u2028/\u2029 escapes, which Roslyn rejects with CS1010 'Newline in constant' - the fix as written does not compile.

R866.note: HttpUtility.HtmlEncode on the interpolated value; minimal, correct, standard fix.

R867.note: Fix only shows adding a new @PostMapping and a separate confirmation-page controller; it never shows removing/replacing the original vulnerable @GetMapping("/account/delete") deletion handler already in AccountController.java, so applied literally the sink remains in place and a second class mapping GET to the same path would also throw an ambiguous-mapping error at Spring startup.
